entries.definition: the amount carried by a vehicle
entries.definitionCN: 车辆所载的量，是 cargo 的上位说法。

normalIntro.en: The word is about loading: cargo is what gets loaded onto a ship.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词的核心是「装载」：cargo 就是被装到船上的货。

normal.en: cargo comes from Spanish cargar, to load, and behind it Latin carrus, a wagon.
normal.cn: cargo 来自西班牙语 cargar（装载），背后是拉丁语 carrus（车）。

normal.en: cargo ship and cargo plane name the carriers built for goods only.
normal.cn: cargo ship 与 cargo plane 指专门运货的船和飞机。

normal.en: a cargo of timber treats cargo as a countable unit when the goods are named.
normal.cn: a cargo of timber 说明当具体货物被点明时，cargo 可以作可数单位。

normal.en: cargo hold is the space inside the ship where the goods sit.
normal.cn: cargo hold 是船内堆放货物的空间，即货舱。

normal.en: The plural cargoes keeps the older -es ending.
normal.cn: 复数 cargoes 保留了较旧的 -es 结尾。

abstract.en: Picture a hold packed with wooden boxes roped down for a storm.
abstract.cn: 想象货舱塞满木箱，为防风暴用绳子固定。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lifting one container from dock to deck.
abstract.cn: 想象起重机把一个集装箱从码头吊到甲板。

abstract.en: Picture a plane with no windows, only a wide loading door.
abstract.cn: 想象一架没有窗户、只有宽大装货门的飞机。

examples.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of timber.
examples.cn: 这艘船装载着一批木材。

examples.en: The port handles cargo from all over the world.
examples.cn: 这个港口处理来自世界各地的货物。

examples.en: The vessel returned with a full cargo of grain.
examples.cn: 这艘船满载谷物返航。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡够」——货装得卡够了位置，就是船上的货。

root: 拉丁语 carrus（车）→ 晚期拉丁语 carricare（装车）→ 西班牙语 cargo（装载）→ 英语 cargo。

sensesIntro.en: Goods and the amount of goods: cargo names both what is loaded and the whole load.
sensesIntro.cn: 货物与货物总量：cargo 既指装上船的货，也指整船的量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ship's hold filled with roped wooden boxes.
core.cn: 核心意象：船舱里塞满用绳固定的木箱。

branches.en: The goods sense: what a ship or aircraft carries.
branches.cn: 货物义：船或飞机运载的东西。

branches.en: The quantity sense: a full load taken as one unit.
branches.cn: 数量义：把满满一船货当成一个整体。

branches.en: cargo ship and cargo plane name vehicles built for goods.
branches.cn: 货船与货机指专为货物建造的运输工具。

branches.en: Both senses keep the idea of loading onto a carrier.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留了「往运输工具上装」的想法。

branches.en: a full cargo marks the maximum a vessel can take.
branches.cn: a full cargo 标记的是一艘船能装的上限。

intro.en: Cargo is a borrowed base noun, and its family comes through the loading root.
intro.cn: cargo 是借入的基础名词，词族经由「装载」这一词根展开。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus and carricare link cargo with charge, carriage, and carrier.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carrus 与 carricare 把 cargo 和 charge、carriage、carrier 连在一起。

items.meaning: goods carried by ship or aircraft
items.example: The cargo was unloaded at dawn.
Two cargoes arrived this week.

items.meaning: to load with a duty, or to ask a price
items.example: They charge a fee for storage.

items.meaning: the act of carrying, or a passenger vehicle
items.example: The carriage of goods by rail is cheap.

items.meaning: a company or vehicle that transports goods
items.example: The carrier delivers to the port.
Freight trains crossed the plain.
Carricare gave Spanish cargar.
items.exampleCN: carricare 演变为西班牙语 cargar。

items.example: Carrus is the oldest link in the chain.
items.exampleCN: carrus 是这条词源链上最古老的一环。

definition_en: a person whose job is to make and repair wooden objects and structures
core_image: 一个人弓着背，把木头一点点刨成想要的形状
scene: 木匠把一块松木刨成了桌面。The carpenter planed a piece of pine into a tabletop.
sceneCN: 这里 carpenter 是「木匠」（第 1 个义项：制作和修理木器的人）；句意是木匠把一块松木刨成了桌面。

derivatives.zh: carpenter 加 -y 构成，义为「木工手艺、木作」
语义关联词，义为「细木工」，专做接合精细木件
语义关联词，义为「木工」，泛指以木材为材料的人

senses.title: A person who works with wood
senses.definition: a person whose job is to cut, shape, and join wood
senses.definitionCN: 以切割、成型和拼接木材为职业的人
senses.example: The carpenter repaired the broken chair.
senses.exampleCN: 木匠修好了那把坏椅子。
senses.why: Latin carpentum meant a wagon, and its maker, carpentarius, gave the word for a woodworker.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 carpentum 指马车，造车者 carpentarius 后来就成了「木匠」一词。

senses.title: A worker on the wooden parts of a building
senses.definition: a worker who builds the wooden frame, doors, and fittings of a house
senses.definitionCN: 负责房屋木构架、门和木制配件的人
senses.example: Carpenters raised the roof frame in one day.
senses.exampleCN: 木工们一天之内就立起了屋顶梁架。
senses.why: The same craft divides into furniture making and building work, so the word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 同一门手艺分成做家具和做建筑两路，所以这个词两者都涵盖。

intro.en: Carpenter began as the name for a wagon maker, then settled on the worker in wood.
intro.cn: carpenter 最初指「造车的人」，后来固定指与木头打交道的工匠。

items.en: carpentum named a two-wheeled covered wagon, probably from a Celtic source.
items.cn: carpentum 指带篷的双轮车，可能源自凯尔特语。

items.en: carpentarius meant a wagon maker or a worker in wood.
items.cn: carpentarius 意为「造车者」或「木工」。

items.en: charpentier named the craftsman who built wooden frames and vehicles.
items.cn: 古法语 charpentier 指搭建木架、制造车辆的工匠。

items.en: English borrowed it as carpenter for anyone skilled in working wood.
items.cn: 英语借入为 carpenter，泛指擅长木作的人。

items.en: Today carpenter covers furniture makers, house framers, and repair workers alike.
items.cn: 今天 carpenter 同时涵盖做家具、搭屋架和修修补补的木工。

note.en: Carpenter has a craft noun in carpentry, and it sits beside other woodworking trades.
note.cn: carpenter 有对应的手艺名词 carpentry，同时和别的木工工种相邻。

entries.definition: the craft of working with wood
entries.definitionCN: 木工手艺，由 carpenter 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: a covered two-wheeled wagon in ancient Rome
entries.definitionCN: 古罗马的带篷双轮车，是 carpenter 的拉丁语源头。

entries.definition: a woodworker who makes joints and fitted furniture
entries.definitionCN: 细木工，专做榫接和嵌入式家具。

entries.definition: a person who makes things from wood
entries.definitionCN: 以木材制作物品的人，是更宽泛的说法。

entries.definition: a person or company that constructs buildings
entries.definitionCN: 建造房屋的人或公司，与建筑木工有工作交叉。

normalIntro.en: The word begins with car because the first carpenters built wagons.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词以 car 开头，因为最早的木匠就是造车的人。

normal.en: carpenter starts like car, and its Latin root carpentum meant a wagon.
normal.cn: carpenter 的开头像 car，其拉丁词根 carpentum 就指马车。

normal.en: carpentarius, the wagon maker, became the general word for a woodworker.
normal.cn: 造车者 carpentarius 后来成了泛指木工的词。

normal.en: carpentry is the craft, carpenter is the person.
normal.cn: carpentry 是手艺，carpenter 是人。

normal.en: carpenter's tools and carpenter's workshop are natural possessive phrases.
normal.cn: 木匠的工具、木匠的作坊，用所有格最自然。

normal.en: The plural carpenters adds only an s.
normal.cn: 复数 carpenters 只加一个 s。

abstract.en: Picture a plane sliding along a board and a curl of wood falling away.
abstract.cn: 想象刨子沿木板推过，卷起一条木花。

abstract.en: Picture a roof frame rising like a skeleton against the sky.
abstract.cn: 想象屋顶梁架像骨架一样在天空下立起。

abstract.en: Picture a hand testing a joint to see if it fits without a nail.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手试着接缝，看能不能不用钉子就严丝合缝。

examples.en: The carpenter planed a piece of pine into a tabletop.
examples.cn: 木匠把一块松木刨成了桌面。

examples.en: The carpenter repaired the broken chair.
examples.cn: 木匠修好了那把坏椅子。

examples.en: Carpenters raised the roof frame in one day.
examples.cn: 木工们一天之内就立起了屋顶梁架。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡盆特」——木头卡在盆边，特制的木匠来修。

root: 拉丁语 carpentum（车）→ carpentarius（造车者）→ 古法语 charpentier → 英语 carpenter。

sensesIntro.en: One craftsman, two workplaces: the furniture bench and the house frame.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个工匠，两个工作场所：做家具的工作台和房屋的梁架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands guiding a tool along wood until the shape appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手引导工具沿木头推进，直到形状显现。

branches.en: The furniture sense: making and repairing wooden objects.
branches.cn: 家具义：制作和修理木制物件。

branches.en: The building sense: raising frames, doors, and fittings.
branches.cn: 建筑义：搭梁架、装门和木配件。

branches.en: Both senses share the same material and the same hand tools.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同样的材料和同样的手工工具。

branches.en: carpentry names the craft that a carpenter practises.
branches.cn: carpentry 指木匠所从事的手艺。

branches.en: On a building site the carpenter works beside bricklayers and roofers.
branches.cn: 在工地上，木工与砌砖工、屋面工并肩作业。

intro.en: Carpenter is an agent noun from Latin carpentarius, a wagon maker.
intro.cn: carpenter 是来自拉丁语 carpentarius（造车者）的施事名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin carpentum, a wagon, and carpentarius, its maker, are the root pair.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carpentum（车）与 carpentarius（造车者）构成词根对。

items.example: The carpenter measured the door twice.
Three carpenters worked on the frame.
He learned carpentry from his uncle.
Carpentum is the oldest form in the family.
items.exampleCN: carpentum 是这个词族里最古老的形式。

items.example: Carpentarius became charpentier in French.
items.exampleCN: carpentarius 在法语中变成 charpentier。

items.example: The joiner fitted the cupboard doors.

items.meaning: a person who works with wood
items.example: The woodworker sells handmade bowls.
items.exampleCN: 这位木工出售手工木碗。

items.meaning: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood
items.example: He cut the joint with a chisel.

definition_en: a thick woven material used to cover floors, or a thick layer of something
core_image: 一块厚布把整片地面铺满
scene: 客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。A thick carpet covered the floor of the living room.
sceneCN: 这里 carpet 是「地毯」（第 1 个义项：铺在地面的厚织物）；句意是客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。

derivatives.zh: carpet 加 -ing 构成，义为「地毯材料；铺地织物」
carpet 加 -ed 构成，义为「铺了地毯的」
carpet 与 bag 复合，义为「旧式旅行毡袋」

senses.title: A thick floor covering
senses.definition: a piece of thick woven material used to cover a floor
senses.definitionCN: 铺在地面上的厚织物
senses.example: The carpet in the hall is old and worn.
senses.exampleCN: 大厅里的地毯又旧又破。
senses.why: The word first named thick woolen cloth, and cloth laid on a floor became a carpet.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指厚毛布，铺在地上的厚布就成了地毯。

senses.title: A thick layer covering a surface
senses.definition: a thick continuous layer of something covering the ground
senses.definitionCN: 厚厚地、连续地盖住地面的一层东西
senses.example: A carpet of fallen leaves covered the path.
senses.exampleCN: 小路上铺满了落叶。
senses.why: A carpet covers a floor completely, so any complete covering can be called a carpet.
senses.whyCN: 地毯把地面整片盖住，因此任何完整覆盖的一层都可以叫 carpet。

intro.en: Carpet goes back to a Latin verb meaning to pluck, because the cloth was made of pulled wool.
intro.cn: carpet 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「撕扯」的动词，因为这种布由扯下的羊毛制成。

items.en: carpere meant to pluck or pull apart, used of wool and fibers.
items.cn: carpere 意为「采摘、扯开」，用于羊毛和纤维。

items.en: carpita named wool or a rough woolen fabric.
items.cn: carpita 指羊毛或粗糙的毛织物。

items.en: carpite named a thick woolen cloth used as a cover.
items.cn: 古法语 carpite 指用作覆盖物的厚毛布。

items.en: English borrowed it as carpet for a table cover, then for a floor covering.
items.cn: 英语借入为 carpet，先指桌布，后指铺地织物。

items.en: The covering sense widened to a carpet of leaves and to carpet as a verb.
items.cn: 覆盖义扩展到「一层落叶」，并产生动词用法。

note.en: Carpet is a cloth word that became a covering word, and it sits beside rug and mat.
note.cn: carpet 由「布」变成「覆盖物」，与 rug、mat 相邻。

entries.definition: material used for making carpets
entries.definitionCN: 制作地毯的材料，由 carpet 加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: an old-fashioned travelling bag made of carpet material
entries.definitionCN: 旧式旅行毡袋，由 carpet 与 bag 复合而成。

entries.definition: rough woolen cloth in Latin
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中的粗毛布，是 carpet 的源头。

entries.definition: a small carpet that does not cover the whole floor
entries.definitionCN: 小块地毯，通常不铺满整个地面。

entries.definition: a small flat piece of material laid on a floor
entries.definitionCN: 铺在地上的小块垫子。

entries.definition: coarse material woven into mats
entries.definitionCN: 编成垫子的粗材料。

normalIntro.en: The word comes from plucked wool: rough cloth first, floor covering later.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词来自被扯下的羊毛：先有粗毛布，后有铺地织物。

normal.en: carpet comes from Latin carpere, to pluck, the same root as excerpt.
normal.cn: carpet 来自拉丁语 carpere（摘、扯），与 excerpt 同根。

normal.en: The first carpets were thick woolen cloths laid over tables or floors.
normal.cn: 最早的地毯是铺在桌上或地上的厚毛布。

normal.en: red carpet is the fixed phrase for an official welcome.
normal.cn: red carpet 是「隆重欢迎」的固定说法。

normal.en: a carpet of leaves uses the covering sense with a named material.
normal.cn: a carpet of leaves 用具体材料来表示「覆盖的一层」。

normal.en: As a verb, carpet means to cover a floor completely.
normal.cn: 作动词时，carpet 指把地面整片铺满。

abstract.en: Picture a thick red cloth laid down a staircase step by step.
abstract.cn: 想象一条厚厚的红布沿着楼梯一级级铺下去。

abstract.en: Picture autumn leaves covering a path so completely that no stone shows.
abstract.cn: 想象秋叶把小路盖得严严实实，一块石头都看不见。

abstract.en: Picture bare feet sinking a little into soft wool.
abstract.cn: 想象赤脚陷进柔软羊毛里一点点。

examples.en: A thick carpet covered the floor of the living room.
examples.cn: 客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。

examples.en: The carpet in the hall is old and worn.
examples.cn: 大厅里的地毯又旧又破。

examples.en: A carpet of fallen leaves covered the path.
examples.cn: 小路上铺满了落叶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡皮特」——皮特把厚厚的布卡在地板上，就是地毯。

root: 拉丁语 carpere（撕扯、摘取）→ carpita（羊毛）→ 古法语 carpite（厚毛布）→ 英语 carpet。

sensesIntro.en: A cloth that covers a floor, then any layer that covers a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是一块铺满地面的布，后来指任何铺满表面的层。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thick cloth spread until the whole floor disappears.
core.cn: 核心意象：厚布铺开，直到整片地面都不见了。

branches.en: The floor sense: woven material covering a room.
branches.cn: 地面义：覆盖房间地面的织物。

branches.en: The layer sense: leaves, snow, or flowers covering the ground.
branches.cn: 覆盖层义：落叶、雪或花铺满地面。

branches.en: red carpet turns the object into a sign of honour.
branches.cn: red carpet 把物件变成了礼遇的象征。

branches.en: Both senses depend on complete coverage rather than a small patch.
branches.cn: 两个义项都强调「整片盖住」，而不是只铺一小块。

branches.en: The verb carpet extends the same image: to cover a surface thickly.
branches.cn: 动词 carpet 延伸同一画面：厚厚地覆盖一个表面。

intro.en: Carpet is a base noun from Latin; -ing and -ed build its small family.
intro.cn: carpet 是来自拉丁语的基础名词，-ing 与 -ed 构成它不大的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin carpere, to pluck, and carpita, wool, explain the word's origin in pulled fiber.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carpere（扯下）与 carpita（羊毛）说明这个词源于被扯下的纤维。

items.meaning: a thick covering for a floor
items.example: The carpet was cleaned last week.

items.meaning: more than one carpet, or covers thickly
items.meaningCN: carpet 的复数，或动词第三人称单数
items.example: The shop sells hand-made carpets.
The stairs were fully carpeted.
They chose a grey carpeting.
items.exampleCN: 他们选了灰色的地毯材料。

items.meaning: an old travelling bag made of carpet cloth
items.example: The doctor carried a carpetbag.
items.exampleCN: 医生提着一个旧式毡袋。

items.example: A rug lay by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 炉火旁铺着一块小地毯。

items.example: Carpere described the pulling of wool.
items.exampleCN: carpere 描写扯下羊毛的动作。

items.example: Carpita is the direct source of carpet.
items.exampleCN: carpita 是 carpet 的直接来源。

definition_en: a vehicle with wheels pulled by horses, or a separate section of a train
core_image: 一个带轮的车厢，被马或机车拉着往前走
scene: 马车沿着乡间小路慢慢走。The carriage moved slowly along the country road.
sceneCN: 这里 carriage 是「马车」（第 1 个义项：由马拉的四轮载客车）；句意是马车沿着乡间小路慢慢走。

derivatives.zh: 与 carriage 同根，义为「携带、运送」
carry 加 -er 构成，义为「承运人、携带者」
carriage 与 way 复合，义为「车行道」

senses.title: A horse-drawn passenger vehicle
senses.definition: a wheeled vehicle pulled by horses and used for carrying passengers
senses.definitionCN: 由马拉动、用来载客的四轮车辆
senses.example: They hired a carriage for the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为婚礼租了一辆马车。
senses.why: Old French cariage meant the act of carrying, and the vehicle that carried people took the name.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 cariage 意为「运送」，用来载人的车便承接了这个名字。

senses.title: A separate section of a train
senses.definition: one of the separate parts of a train where passengers sit
senses.definitionCN: 列车中供乘客乘坐的一节独立部分
senses.example: We found seats in the last carriage.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在最后一节车厢找到了座位。
senses.why: A railway carriage is the same wheeled passenger box, now pulled by an engine.
senses.whyCN: 火车车厢就是同一个载人带轮盒子，只是改由机车牵引。

senses.title: The transport of goods
senses.definition: the business or cost of moving goods from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把货物从一处运到另一处的业务或费用
senses.example: The contract covers the carriage of goods by sea.
senses.exampleCN: 这份合同涵盖海运货物运输。
senses.why: The oldest abstract sense is simply carrying, which survives in trade and legal language.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的抽象义就是「运送」，它保留在贸易与法律用语中。

intro.en: Carriage first meant the act of carrying, then the vehicle that does the carrying.
intro.cn: carriage 最初指「运送」这个动作，后来指执行运送的车辆。

items.en: carrus named a wagon, the root of the whole carrying family.
items.cn: carrus 指马车，是整组「运送」词汇的根。

items.en: carricare meant to load a cart with goods.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 carricare 意为「往车上装货」。

items.en: cariage named the act of transporting and the charge for it.
items.cn: 古法语 cariage 指运输行为及其费用。

items.en: English borrowed carriage for transport, then for the coach that carried people.
items.cn: 英语借入 carriage 指运输，随后指载人的马车。

items.en: Railways gave the word its sense of a passenger car, which remains in British English.
items.cn: 铁路赋予它「客车车厢」的义项，这一用法保留在英式英语中。

note.en: Carriage is the vehicle and the act, and it shares its root with carry and cargo.
note.cn: carriage 既是车辆也是行为，并与 carry、cargo 同根。

entries.definition: to hold something and take it somewhere
entries.definitionCN: 携带、运送，与 carriage 同根。

entries.definition: a person or company that transports goods
entries.definitionCN: 承运人、运输公司，由 carry 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: goods carried by ship or aircraft
entries.definitionCN: 船或飞机运载的货物，与 carriage 同出 carricare。

entries.definition: a strong four-wheeled vehicle for loads
entries.definitionCN: 结实的四轮载货车，与马车同类。

entries.definition: a comfortable bus or a horse-drawn passenger vehicle
entries.definitionCN: 舒适的长途客车，或旧时的载客马车。

entries.definition: a small vehicle pushed or pulled by hand or animal
entries.definitionCN: 手推或畜拉的小车。

normalIntro.en: Carriage is the noun of carrying: the act first, the vehicle second.
normalIntro.cn: carriage 是「运送」的名词：先有动作，后有车辆。

normal.en: carriage and carry share the same root, from Latin carricare, to load.
normal.cn: carriage 与 carry 同根，来自拉丁语 carricare（装车）。

normal.en: The -age ending often makes a noun of action, as in carriage and marriage.
normal.cn: -age 结尾常把动作变成名词，如 carriage、marriage。

normal.en: railway carriage is the British term for a passenger car.
normal.cn: railway carriage 是英式英语里「客车车厢」的说法。

normal.en: carriage of goods keeps the abstract transport sense in legal writing.
normal.cn: carriage of goods 在法律文本里保留了抽象的「货运」义。

normal.en: baby carriage is the American term for a pram.
normal.cn: baby carriage 是美式英语中的「婴儿推车」。

abstract.en: Picture four wheels, a wooden box, and two horses pulling it along a lane.
abstract.cn: 想象四个轮子、一个木箱，两匹马拉着它沿小路走。

abstract.en: Picture a train made of separate boxes linked one behind another.
abstract.cn: 想象一列火车由一节节独立盒子前后相连。

abstract.en: Picture boxes being weighed and marked before a long journey.
abstract.cn: 想象箱子在长途运输前被称重、做标记。

examples.en: The carriage moved slowly along the country road.
examples.cn: 马车沿着乡间小路慢慢走。

examples.en: We found seats in the last carriage.
examples.cn: 我们在最后一节车厢找到了座位。

examples.en: The contract covers the carriage of goods by sea.
examples.cn: 这份合同涵盖海运货物运输。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开瑞吉」——车拉着人一路往前，轮子吱吱作响。

root: 拉丁语 carrus（车）→ 晚期拉丁语 carricare（装车）→ 古法语 cariage（运送）→ 英语 carriage。

sensesIntro.en: The act of carrying becomes the vehicle that carries, on road and on rail.
sensesIntro.cn: 「运送」这个动作变成了执行运送的车辆，公路上与铁路上都是。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wheeled box being pulled along with people or goods inside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个带轮盒子被人或货装满，正被拉着走。

branches.en: The road sense: a horse-drawn vehicle for passengers.
branches.cn: 公路义：由马拉的载客车辆。

branches.en: The rail sense: one passenger section of a train.
branches.cn: 铁路义：列车的一节载客车厢。

branches.en: The trade sense: the business and cost of moving goods.
branches.cn: 贸易义：运送货物的业务与费用。

branches.en: Both vehicle senses keep the same box on wheels, only the power changes.
branches.cn: 两个车辆义都是同一个带轮盒子，只是动力来源不同。

branches.en: carriage of goods survives mainly in contracts and shipping documents.
branches.cn: carriage of goods 主要保留在合同与货运单据中。

intro.en: Carriage is formed on the carrying root with the noun ending -age.
intro.cn: carriage 建立在「运送」词根上，加名词词尾 -age。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus and carricare are the source of carriage, carry, cargo, and carrier.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carrus 与 carricare 是 carriage、carry、cargo、carrier 的共同来源。

items.meaning: a passenger vehicle or the act of transporting
items.example: The carriage stopped at the gate.
The train had eight carriages.

items.meaning: to take something from one place to another
items.example: She carried the box upstairs.

items.meaning: a person or company that transports goods
items.example: The carrier lost the parcel.

items.meaning: goods carried by ship or aircraft
items.example: The cargo was checked at the port.

items.meaning: the part of a road used by vehicles
items.example: The carriageway was closed for repairs.
Carricare gave French charger.
Carrus stands at the head of the family.
items.exampleCN: carrus 位于这个词族的最前端。

definition_zh: 运输公司；承运人；携带者；载体
definition_en: a person, company, or thing that carries goods, people, or disease
core_image: 一个人或一件东西，把某物从一处带到另一处
scene: 这家航空公司是那批货物的承运方。The airline was the carrier for the shipment.
sceneCN: 这里 carrier 是「承运方」（第 1 个义项：负责运输货物的人或公司）；句意是这家航空公司是那批货物的承运方。

pos.zh: 承运人；运输公司；携带者；载体

derivatives.zh: carrier 的基础动词，义为「携带、运送」
与 carrier 同根，义为「马车；车厢；运输」
语义关联词，义为「船货、货物」

senses.title: A company or person that transports goods
senses.definition: a company or person whose business is moving goods or passengers
senses.definitionCN: 以运送货物或乘客为业务的公司或个人
senses.example: The carrier delivers parcels across the country.
senses.exampleCN: 这家承运公司在全国范围内递送包裹。
senses.why: Carrier is simply carry plus -er, the one who carries.
senses.whyCN: carrier 就是 carry 加 -er，即「执行运送的人或物」。

senses.title: A person or animal that spreads disease
senses.definition: a person or animal that has a disease and can pass it to others
senses.definitionCN: 带有疾病并能把疾病传给他人的人或动物
senses.example: Mosquitoes are carriers of the disease.
senses.exampleCN: 蚊子是这种疾病的携带者。
senses.why: A carrier holds the germ without always being ill, just as a vehicle holds goods.
senses.whyCN: 携带者身上带着病菌却不一定发病，就像运输工具装着货物。

senses.title: A thing that holds or supports something
senses.definition: an object or structure that holds, supports, or transports something
senses.definitionCN: 承载、支撑或运送某物的物体或结构
senses.example: The bicycle has a carrier over the back wheel.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆自行车后轮上方有一个货架。
senses.why: The same agent ending extends from people and companies to any object that bears a load.
senses.whyCN: 同一个施事后缀从人和公司扩展到任何承担负载的物体。

intro.en: Carrier is formed in English from carry plus -er, on a root that goes back to the Latin wagon.
intro.cn: carrier 是英语里由 carry 加 -er 构成的，词根可追溯到拉丁语的「车」。

items.en: carrus named a wagon, the distant source of the carrying family.
items.cn: carrus 指马车，是这组「运送」词汇的远源。

items.en: carricare meant to load a cart with goods.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 carricare 意为「往车上装货」。

items.en: carier meant to carry or transport, and English borrowed it as carry.
items.cn: 古北法语 carier 意为「运送」，英语借入为 carry。

items.en: carien settled into English as the everyday verb for carrying.
items.cn: carien 进入英语，成为日常表示「携带」的动词。

items.en: carrier appeared as the agent noun, naming the person or company that carries.
items.cn: 十六世纪出现施事名词 carrier，指执行运送的人或公司。

abstract.en: Picture a metal rack over a bicycle wheel holding a parcel steady.

examples.en: Mosquitoes are carriers of the disease.

sensesIntro.en: Whoever carries: a company, a mosquito, or a metal rack all bear something.
sensesIntro.cn: 谁在运送：公司、蚊子、金属架，都在承担某样东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bearer holding something and moving it to another place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个承载者拿着某物，把它移到别处。

branches.en: The business sense: the company that moves goods.
branches.cn: 商业义：运送货物的公司。

branches.en: The medical sense: a body that holds and spreads a germ.
branches.cn: 医学义：带有并传播病菌的身体。

branches.en: The object sense: a rack, bag, or ship that bears a load.
branches.cn: 器物义：承托负载的架子、袋子或船只。

branches.en: All senses are the agent of carry, applied to different kinds of bearers.
branches.cn: 三个义项都是 carry 的施事，只是承载者种类不同。

branches.en: Legal and shipping texts use carrier for the party responsible for the goods.
branches.cn: 法律与航运文本用 carrier 指对货物负责的一方。

definition_en: a long orange root vegetable, or something offered as a reward to persuade someone
core_image: 一根橙色的根从土里被拔出来，还带着泥
scene: 她从地里拔出一根胡萝卜。She pulled a carrot out of the ground.
sceneCN: 这里 carrot 是「胡萝卜」（第 1 个义项：一种橙色根菜）；句意是她从地里拔出一根胡萝卜。

senses.title: The long orange root vegetable

senses.definitionCN: 一种长而尖的橙色根，作为蔬菜食用

senses.title: A reward used to persuade

senses.definitionCN: 用来吸引并说服某人行动的好处
senses.example: The bonus was a carrot to attract new staff.
senses.exampleCN: 奖金是吸引新员工的诱饵。
senses.why: A carrot is held in front of a donkey to make it move, and the image became a metaphor for incentives.

intro.en: Carrot travelled from Greek to Latin to French before reaching English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: carrot 从希腊语经拉丁语、法语，在十六世纪进入英语。

items.en: karoton named the carrot plant, a word of uncertain earlier origin.
items.cn: karoton 指胡萝卜这种植物，更早的来源尚不确定。

items.en: carota was the Latin name for the same root vegetable.
items.cn: carota 是拉丁语对同一种根菜的称呼。

items.en: carotte kept the vegetable sense in medieval and early modern French.
items.cn: carotte 在中古及近代早期法语中保留了这一蔬菜义。

items.en: English borrowed the word as carrot, describing the orange root we know.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入为 carrot，指我们今天熟悉的橙色根菜。

items.en: The metaphor of the dangling carrot added the sense of a reward or incentive.
items.cn: 「吊着的胡萝卜」这一比喻又添上了「奖励、激励」的义项。

note.en: Carrot has a chemical relative in carotene, and it sits beside other root vegetables.
note.cn: carrot 在化学词汇里有 carotene 这个亲戚，同时和别的根菜相邻。

entries.definition: the orange substance in carrots that the body turns into vitamin A
entries.definitionCN: 胡萝卜素，胡萝卜中使人体合成维生素甲的橙色物质。

entries.definition: orange-red in colour, like a carrot
entries.definitionCN: 胡萝卜色的，指橙红色，由 carrot 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: the Latin name for the carrot
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中的「胡萝卜」，是英语 carrot 的直接源头。

entries.definition: a round white root vegetable
entries.definitionCN: 圆形的白色根菜，与胡萝卜同属根菜。

entries.definition: a small red or white root with a sharp taste
entries.definitionCN: 小红萝卜或白萝卜，味道辛辣。

entries.definition: a plant grown for food
entries.definitionCN: 作为食物种植的植物，是 carrot 的上位词。

normalIntro.en: One orange root, and a metaphor about donkeys and rewards.
normalIntro.cn: 一根橙色根菜，外加一个关于驴子与奖励的比喻。

normal.en: carrot comes through French carotte from Latin carota.
normal.cn: carrot 经法语 carotte 来自拉丁语 carota。

normal.en: carotene, the orange substance, keeps the same stem.
normal.cn: 橙色的胡萝卜素 carotene 保留了同一个词干。

normal.en: carrot and stick names the two tools of persuasion, reward and threat.
normal.cn: carrot and stick 指奖励与威胁两种手段。

normal.cn: 胡萝卜丝与胡萝卜蛋糕是常见说法。

abstract.en: Picture a bright orange root pulled from dark soil, soil still clinging to it.
abstract.cn: 想象一根亮橙色的根从黑土里拔出，还带着泥。

abstract.cn: 想象一根胡萝卜系在棍上，吊在行走的驴子前面。

abstract.cn: 想象一盘橙色薄片旁边放着一份绿色沙拉。

root: 希腊语 karoton → 拉丁语 carota → 法语 carotte → 英语 carrot；同族词有 carotene。

sensesIntro.en: The vegetable comes first; the reward metaphor hangs it in front of someone.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有这种蔬菜，后来「奖励」的比喻把它吊在了人面前。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long orange root lifted out of the earth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根长长的橙色根从土里被拔起。

branches.en: The food sense: the orange root eaten raw or cooked.
branches.cn: 食物义：可生吃或熟食的橙色根菜。

branches.en: The incentive sense: a reward dangled to produce action.
branches.cn: 激励义：吊在前面促使人行动的好处。

branches.en: carrot juice and carrot cake show the vegetable in compounds.
branches.cn: 胡萝卜汁与胡萝卜蛋糕展示了这种蔬菜的复合用法。

branches.en: The metaphor works because the vegetable is bright, cheap, and easy to dangle.
branches.cn: 这个比喻成立，是因为胡萝卜颜色醒目、便宜、又容易吊起来。

branches.en: carrot and stick pairs the reward with a threat.
branches.cn: carrot and stick 把奖励与威胁配成一对。

intro.cn: carrot 是源自希腊语的基础名词，词族靠 -y 与复合构词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin carota is the bridge between Greek karoton and English carrot.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carota 是希腊语 karoton 与英语 carrot 之间的桥。

definition_en: to hold something and take it from one place to another
core_image: 双手把东西抱起来，一路带到别处
scene: 他两手抱着箱子走上楼。He carried the box upstairs in both arms.
sceneCN: 这里 carried 是 carry 的过去式，意为「搬运、抱着」（第 1 个义项：用手拿着东西移动）；句意是他两手抱着箱子走上楼。

derivatives.zh: carry 加 -er 构成，义为「承运人、携带者」
与 carry 同根，义为「马车；车厢；运输」
同根名词，义为「船货、货物」

senses.title: To hold and move something
senses.definition: to hold something in your hands or arms while you move
senses.definitionCN: 移动时用手或手臂拿着某物
senses.example: She carried the baby up the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 她抱着婴儿上楼。
senses.why: The word came from a verb meaning to transport, and the simplest form is carrying by hand.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自表示「运送」的动词，最基本的形式就是用手搬运。

senses.title: To transport goods or passengers
senses.definition: to take goods or people from one place to another in a vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 用交通工具把货物或人从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The train carries hundreds of passengers each day.
senses.exampleCN: 这列火车每天运送数百名乘客。
senses.why: The same verb widens from a person's hands to a ship, train, or plane.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词从人的双手扩展到船、火车和飞机。

senses.title: To support the weight of something
senses.definition: to support the weight or burden of something
senses.definitionCN: 支撑某物的重量或负担
senses.example: These pillars carry the weight of the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 这些柱子承受屋顶的重量。
senses.why: If you carry a load, you bear its weight, and pillars and beams do the same.
senses.whyCN: 人搬东西时要承受重量，柱子和横梁做的是同一件事。

intro.en: Carry entered English from northern French, and its root goes back to the Latin wagon.
intro.cn: carry 从法国北方方言进入英语，词根可追溯到拉丁语的「车」。

items.en: carrus named a wagon, the distant source of the carrying family.
items.cn: carrus 指马车，是这组「运送」词汇的远源。

items.en: carricare meant to load a cart with goods.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 carricare 意为「往车上装货」。

items.en: carier meant to transport or convey, and it was this form that crossed the Channel.
items.cn: 古北法语 carier 意为「运送、传送」，正是这个形式渡过了海峡。

items.en: carien became the everyday English verb for carrying.
items.cn: carien 成为英语中日常表示「携带」的动词。

items.en: The verb widened to vehicles, loads, responsibilities, and fixed phrases such as carry out.
items.cn: 这个动词扩展到交通工具、负载、责任，以及 carry out 等固定搭配。

note.en: Carry is the base of carrier, carriage, and cargo, and its near meanings split holding from transporting.
note.cn: carry 是 carrier、carriage、cargo 的基础，近义词则把「拿着」与「运输」区分开。

normalIntro.en: A short verb whose family shows every stage: hand, vehicle, pillar, phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 一个短动词，词族展示了它的每一站：手、车、柱子、短语。

normal.en: carry, carrier, carriage, and cargo all share one root, from Latin carricare.
normal.cn: carry、carrier、carriage、cargo 共享一个词根，来自拉丁语 carricare。

normal.en: carry on means continue, as if carrying the work forward.
normal.cn: carry on 意为「继续」，像把工作继续搬着往前走。

normal.en: carry out means perform, taking a plan from paper into action.
normal.cn: carry out 意为「执行」，把计划从纸上搬进行动。

normal.en: Pillars carry a roof, which links the verb to support.
normal.cn: 柱子 carry 屋顶，这就把动词和「支撑」连了起来。

normal.en: The third person carries changes y to ies.
normal.cn: 第三人称 carries 把 y 变成 ies。

abstract.cn: 想象一艘船载着货物的重量在水面上行进。

abstract.en: Picture a stone pillar holding up a roof without any visible effort.
abstract.cn: 想象一根石柱不动声色地撑起屋顶。

sensesIntro.en: Hands, vehicles, and pillars all carry: they hold something and bear its weight elsewhere.
sensesIntro.cn: 手、车、柱子都在 carry：拿着某物，并把它的重量承住。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arms wrapped around a load, moving it steadily.
core.cn: 核心意象：双臂环抱着负载，稳稳地移动。

branches.en: The hand sense: holding something while walking.
branches.cn: 手工义：边走边拿着东西。

branches.en: The vehicle sense: a train or ship moving goods and people.
branches.cn: 交通义：火车或船运送货物与人。

branches.en: The structural sense: a pillar bearing weight.
branches.cn: 结构义：柱子承受重量。

branches.en: All senses share holding plus bearing, whether by hand, engine, or stone.
branches.cn: 三个义项都包含「拿着并承重」，只是靠手、发动机还是石头。

branches.en: Phrases such as carry out and carry on extend the verb into abstract action.
